role: The strap link state machine: applies ordered SDK events (connect, drop, readiness, power, battery, device info), waits for feature readiness, reconnects after unexpected drops with a 20-min session window, reads recording status on connect, and watches HR-feed health (resubscribe / link reset).
types: StrapLinkCoordinator: struct (@MainActor) — stateless, built on demand by PolarManager.link (PolarManager.swift:101); state lives in PolarManager and StrapLinkRuntime
toplevel: Computed helpers runtime/feed; SDK calls compiled under #if canImport(PolarBleSdk) (releaseStandardHeartRate, requestReconnect, beginLinkReset return/do nothing without it).

units.does: Returns manager.linkRuntime.
Builds a StrapHeartRateFeed for the manager.
Starts (once) a Task that iterates the StrapEventPump stream and applies each event via manager.link.apply; captures the manager weakly so events after it is gone are dropped.

branches.effect: each event applied in order; ends when the pump finishes (runtime deinit)

units.does: Sets connectionState .connecting unless already connected, and logs.

New SDK link: clears the previous link's tasks/reconnect state, adopts the device (id/type/state/pairing/last-connected/battery counters), bumps readiness generation, stamps linkedAt/peripheral, sets feedStatus .settingUp, counts a mid-session restore, fires the signal, then starts the HR feed, health watch, readiness-settle timer and recording-status check for the new generation.

branches.cond: reconnectTargetId was set and a session is streaming
branches.effect: true: streamingReconnectCount += 1 and log; false: nothing

units.does: Releases the standard Heart Rate Service subscription and its own CoreBluetooth connection.
Cancels the previous link's tasks and the reconnect deadline, and clears reconnectTargetId, linkResetInProgress and userDisconnectRequested.

Records the connected device on the manager (id, type, pending cleared, .connected, lastConnectedTime=now persisted), moves it to the front of known devices (persisted), and restores its battery-usage counters before any battery callback.

Handles a drop of the connected/pending strap: cancels link tasks, releases the standard HR link, marks readiness lost, feedStatus waitingForStrap, fires the signal, logs, clears link readings (keeping device identity while streaming) and decides recovery; drops for other devices or when nothing is linked/connecting only clear userDisconnectRequested.

branches.effect: false: clears userDisconnectRequested and returns (stale/foreign drop ignored); true: full drop handling

units.does: After a drop: skips if the drop was deliberate; device-command drop clears the reconnect target and, during a session, sets reconnectExhausted so the session is told now (as for a lost pairing); lost pairing stops reconnecting; connection loss of a real link re-asserts connect and, during a session, arms the 20-min deadline.

branches.effect: true: return (user disconnect or link reset handled); false: switch on loss
true: reconnectExhausted = true (the session stops waiting for the strap); false: nothing more
pairingLost: no reconnect, lastError pairingLost, session told now
false: return — a connect attempt that never linked is left to the SDK; true: requestReconnect
true: arm reconnect deadline; false: none

units.does: True when the drop was caused by the app: a user disconnect (flag cleared, reconnect target cleared) or a health-policy link reset (flag cleared, reconnect requested, deadline armed if streaming).

branches.effect: true: clear flag + target, return true; false: continue
false: return false; true: clear flag, reconnect, maybe arm deadline, return true

units.does: Loops until readiness gives an outcome for `feature` (ready/unavailable/unconfirmed), keepWaiting turns false or the task is cancelled (→ .timedOut), or the deadline passes (→ .timedOut); otherwise waits on the signal up to the remaining time (no timeout when deadline is nil). Spans disconnects.

units.does: Waits until `feature` may be attempted (awaitUsable), runs `operation`; on success confirms the feature for that generation and returns; retries only 'not ready yet' errors (StrapErrorClassifier: featureNotReady, notificationNotEnabled, gattDisconnected) with 1/2/3/5 s pauses until the deadline; any other error is thrown. keepWaiting and Task cancellation are consulted inside awaitFeature while readiness has no outcome and before every retry (pauseBeforeRetrying), so a caller's Cancel or a cancelled task ends the retries with the last refusal.

branches.effect: loops until success or a thrown error
true: refusals+1 and pauseBeforeRetrying (rethrows past the deadline, when keepWaiting is false, or when the task is cancelled); other errors propagate to the caller
